notes.title: Orcz Evolve VR Release Date News (UPDATED!)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31451983/aaaaad4b9d4fdf347be1def128c10ece83ad91a0.gif[/img]

Hey Folks! ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː

Firstly, the most important announcement:
Orcz Evolve VR arrives in Steam on April 25, 2018. 

We are extremely sorry for remaining silent for a couple of days.

After a short deliberation we have decided to postpone the release date of our upcoming title Orcz Evolve VR. This was a difficult decision, nonetheless it was mandatory in terms of following our vision, especially product quality assurance principles. We found ourselves with a product which wasn't ready to be unfolded to our audience. This is the sole reason why we were forced to decide to give it some more time to be polished and tuned. We, developers at ARLOOPA value our player's precious time and faith in us above all. 

We'll be posting another gameplay video in the coming days, so that you have a better overview of what's the current situation with the game's progress. And also, we'll be conducting a regular dev blog as we've done with the "OrcSlappin'" video on Facebook.

Feel free to comment, ask question, open up new threads and show some activity, we're here to answer your every question.

We want to thank you all for your kind words, and the faith you have in us. We'll do everything in our power to stand to it.

Best Regards,
ARLOOPA Inc. GameDev Team.
CHEERS! ːsteamhappyː

UPDATE 4/25/2018

Greetings to 5009craig, and all who are tuned in!!!.

First of all, we are extremely thankful that you are still with us,

Unfortunately, us and Steam Publishing Team have found a technical issue with the installation process. This is an absolutely technical issue, and we have already resolved it and reapplied for review, but we cannot give you an update on when the game is going to be available to you, Steam users, but we can surely say that it's going to be available in the nearest future (approx 2-3 days). This process is not ours to catalyze, What I can surely say, there are no other issues regarding the process that we are currently in, both our and Steam Publishing Team are doing their best to rapidly make the game available to everyone.
We kindly ask every one and each of you to remain with us, the game is in the final stage of becoming available to you. We are extremely sorry for this unfortunate flow of events.

IMPORTANT!!!
As a sign of apology we are going to give away 10 keys for FREE on our Facebook page, so stay tuned, we will post additional details on our Steam and Facebook pages.

ALSO,
A short gameplay video is coming to you guys today, so that all of you guys are sure the project is not asleep, and a rapid progress is being made.

Again, would like to apologize for this, but we hope you stay with us in these moments.

Best of luck to us all,
Levon Demurchyan,
ARLOOPA Inc., Game Development Team
